answer.reason: The verses tell of Manasseh's idolatry and bloodshed, his captivity in Babylon and his restoration after prayer.

clauses.english: rebuilt the high places and built altars for the host of heaven in the house of the LORD
clauses.quote: he built altars for all the host of heaven in the two courts of the house of the LORD

clauses.english: shed innocent blood in great measure and led Judah into sin
clauses.quote: Manasseh shed innocent blood very much, till he had filled Jerusalem from one end to another

clauses.english: was taken by the Assyrians in chains to Babylon, and after he prayed was brought back to Jerusalem
clauses.quote: which took Manasseh among the thorns, and bound him with fetters, and carried him to Babylon

doubts: 2KI 21:6 and 2CH 33:6 (passing his son through the fire) were left as detail within his idolatry.
2KI 24:3 and JER 15:4 give his sins as the reason for Judah's removal; this is not a deed of his own, so it is not a clause.
